column1: # 复姓表（扩展）— compound surname table (extension)
#   surname  复姓本身（两字或更多）/ the compound surname (two or more characters)
#   pinyin   整个复姓的读音，无声调小写全拼，不加分隔
#   initial  pinyin 的首字母大写（冗余列，便于人工校对）
#   note     自由文本备注 / free-text note (may contain commas)
#   * 本文件是【增量】。67 条常见复姓已内建在 ChineseSurnameTable.BUILT_IN_COMPOUND 中。
#     This file is ADDITIVE; 67 common compounds are already compiled into the class.
#   * 复姓匹配【最长优先】，且整体优先于单字多音姓表。
#     所以「单于」(Chányú) 一定会赢过单字「单」(Shàn)，「长孙」(Zhǎngsūn) 赢过「长」(Cháng)。
#     Compound matching is LONGEST-FIRST and outranks the single-character table entirely.
#   * 新增一条首字为多音字的复姓时，务必跑一次 host 单测：
#     ChineseSurnameTable.validateBuiltInTables() 会自动检查「遮蔽」问题，无需手写用例。
#     When adding a compound whose first char is polyphonic
#     validateBuiltInTables() derives the shadowing check from the data itself.
#   * 支持三字及以上复姓（如少数民族译名），解析器按码点最长匹配，无需改代码。
#     Three-character-plus surnames are supported; the parser matches longest-first by code point.
